d:
Jile ke dakshini ilake ke logon ke lie bholanath phlaeeovar mahaj ek pul nahin, balki varshon se jam aur badhal yatayat vyavastha se mukti ki ummid hai, lekin ab us ummid par pani phirta huaa dikhaee de raha hai, kyonki nirdharit samay bitne ke bad bhi pariyojna adhuri hai. aise men nirman ki dhimi raphtar ne 40 hajar logon ki pareshani barha di hai. ab saval hai ki aakhir phlaeeovar ka nirman kab pura hoga.
